summary: IsoEnergy Ltd., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its Management's Discussion and Analysis and unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, dated November 4, 2026. The exhibits are incorporated by reference into the registrant's Form F-10 and Form S-8 registration statements. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed; the filing is an ordinary quarterly reporting event, equivalent to a US quarterly report on Form 10-Q, with no special-situation angle to monitor.
